title: Approve: Commit the new sub-account
reason: 'Confirm' cannot be undone, so a person must decide
instructions: Click 'Take this ticket'. The bank screen on the right becomes yours to use.
Check that the screen matches the request (member number ***56, share type REGULAR SAVINGS, initial deposit ***00).
If it does, click 'Confirm' on the screen yourself. This can't be undone.
Then click 'I clicked it, carry on', and the automation finishes the job.
If anything looks wrong, click 'Don't do it' instead. Nothing is submitted.
